subject: Need help feeding in data files.

messages.author: 0490c034b26c6223
messages.subject: Need help feeding in data files.
parts:
My input files are tab delimited text files that look like the following without headers.

chr start end strand coverage %_methylation
chr1 123456 123456 F 20 50
chr1 23456 23456 F 30 45
etc.


I am using the following commands to input data:


file.list = list("EOC_91_methylKit.txt", "EOC_100_3rd_methylKit.txt", "NO19_methylKit.txt")

myobj = read(file.list, sample.id = list("EOC_91", "EOC_100", "NO19"), treatment = c(1,1,0),
assembly = "hg19", header = FALSE, context = "CpG", resolution = "base",
pipeline=list(fraction=FALSE,chr.col=1,start.col=2,end.col=3,strand.col=4, coverage.col=5,freqC.col=6 ))


I am getting the following error:

> file.list = list("EOC_91_methylKit.txt", "EOC_100_3rd_methylKit.txt", "NO19_methylKit.txt")
>
> myobj = read(file.list, sample.id = list("EOC_91", "EOC_100", "NO19"), treatment = c(1,1,0),
+ assembly = "hg19", header = FALSE, context = "CpG", resolution = "base",
+ pipeline=list(fraction=FALSE,chr.col=1,start.col=2,end.col=3,strand.col=4, coverage.col=5,freqC.col=6 ))
Error in scan(file, what, nmax, sep, dec, quote, skip, nlines, na.strings,  :
  scan() expected 'a logical', got 'FF'
Calls: read -> read -> .readTableFast -> read.table -> scan
Execution halted

Thanks

Dave

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Need help feeding in data files.
parts:
First make sure you don't have "FF" string in the strand column, it should have F or R, or better + or -
If it still doesn't work , You can try to install the development version.

Best,
Altuna
